POP series

POP Series 3

Released April 1, 2006 · 17 cards

POP Series 3 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on April 1, 2006. It has 17 cards. It includes 15 Pokémon, 2 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

9 illustrators worked on POP Series 3. Most cards: Masakazu Fukuda (4), Midori Harada (3), Mitsuhiro Arita (3), Sumiyoshi Kizuki (2), Kagemaru Himeno (1), Ken Ikuji (1), Shin-ichi Yoshikawa (1), Tomoaki Imakuni (1).
